feat(camellia): migrate ota and device console pages

Summary:
- add shared DAM-27 workspace config and route components for OTA,
  device, IoT card, and material purchase pages
- wire list, item, manage, and setting routes into camellia and
  expose the visible menu entries in the shared navigation shell
- extend seeded permission nodes to cover hidden subpages and
  pattern-match dynamic route paths during access checks

Rationale:
- DAM-27 requires a baseline migration for the OTA and device menu
  slice plus hidden operational subpages in the new admin shell
- a single shared implementation keeps list/detail/manage/setting
  flows consistent across the migrated domains

Tests:
- cd bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia
- PORT=3210 pnpm --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/ota/manage
- curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/ota/device-blacklist
- curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/iot_card/card/item/iot-card-cn11
- curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3210/universal/material-purchase/setting
